criterion: AC1: The service uses the common metrics agreed in EUDPA-632 (call counts, errors and times for outbound calls)
AC2: Dependencies listed and extra metrics agreed and recorded on the ticket
AC3: CDP default dashboard and default alerts checked in Grafana
AC4: The service publishes the common and extra metrics
AC5: The service records whether each dependency is available as a metric
AC6: For each call to an external dependency, the service logs how long the call took with dependency name, outcome and trace.id
AC7: The service has a custom Grafana dashboard showing its metrics and dependency status
AC8: The service's /health endpoint is not changed
AC9: The service has custom alerts including dependency unavailable, built and promoted through #cdp-support
AC10: Default and custom alerts reach the INS team in the agreed Slack channels
AC11: Each custom alert has been tested in dev and test to fire and reach the team
AC12: A request can be followed across services in OpenSearch using its trace.id
AC13: Anything the skill got wrong or missed is fixed in the skill as we go
